title: Floor Loading by Payroll Groups on the Earned Wage Access Agreement — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service
content:
**Clause.** An employer whose live Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement runs 3 or more payroll groups adds 15 percent to the replenishment floor of its Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service, one whose live agreement runs two payroll groups adds 5 percent, and any other employer adds nothing for payroll groups.

Payroll groups are the pay schedules or legal entities set up on the program; their number is the payroll group count recorded on the employer's live Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement.

| The employer's agreement | Loading |
|---|---|
| live, 3 or more payroll groups | 15 percent |
| live, two payroll groups | 5 percent |
| live, one payroll group | nothing |
| no live agreement | nothing |

**Basis questions.** *Does an agreement with four payroll groups that is still implementing add anything?* No; only a live agreement counts. *Does a live agreement with exactly three groups add 15 percent?* Yes; three is 3 or more.
